reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every natural number n with 3 ≤ n and every real number κ with 4 ≤ κ, let E be real n-dimensional Euclidean space, with coordinates indexed by Fin n = {0, …, n−1}, and let S = {y ∈ E : ‖y‖ = 1} be the unit-sphere subtype. Set s = √κ and r = (1 − 1/n)((s − 1)/(s + 1)), with n interpreted as a real number in these expressions, and let j₀ be coordinate 0 in Fin n.

Let τ be the measure (volume on E).toSphere on S. Thus, for every measurable subset B of S, τ(B) is n times the Euclidean Lebesgue volume of the cone {a z : 0 < a < 1, z ∈ B}. Let ι : S → E be the subtype inclusion and define the ambient measure σ on E by σ = (τ(S))⁻¹ • (ι_*τ). Here the inverse mass and scalar multiplication of the measure use extended nonnegative real scalars.

Define the real-valued function f on E by
f(y) = ((s + 1)y₀ − (s − 1)) / (1 + r² − 2r y₀)^(n/2),
where y₀ is coordinate j₀ of y and n/2 is real division. Then f is absolutely Bochner integrable with respect to σ, and its real Bochner integral over E satisfies
∫_E f(y) dσ(y) = −(s − 1)/(n(1 − r²)).

The exponent n/2 denotes the real power Real.rpow, defined for all real bases; the squares have natural exponent 2. All displayed real divisions and inverses have their totalized Lean meaning. Integrability is part of the conclusion, not a premise.

objects.E: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), with its standard ℓ2 norm and coordinates indexed from 0 through n−1.
objects.j0: The element of Fin n with value 0; existence follows from 3 ≤ n.
objects.tau: (volume : Measure E).toSphere, a measure on S with the stated cone-volume definition.
objects.sigma: (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map ι; this is a measure on E, with extended nonnegative scalar normalization.

domains.integral_type: Real Bochner integral on E with respect to σ.

quantifiers: For every n : ℕ satisfying 3 ≤ n.
For every κ : ℝ satisfying 4 ≤ κ.
All subsequently introduced objects are let-defined from n and κ, with no existentially chosen parameters.
The integral binds y over E; the integrability assertion applies to the whole function f on E under σ.

conclusion.integrability: Integrable f σ: genuine absolute real Bochner integrability.
conclusion.logical_form: The integrability assertion and the integral identity both hold.

scopes.ambient_measure: The integral is on ambient Euclidean space under the explicitly normalized pushforward σ. τ itself is a measure on the sphere subtype.
scopes.normalization: τ Set.univ is the mass of the whole sphere subtype; its ENNReal inverse scales the pushforward.
scopes.coordinates: Only coordinate j₀ = 0 occurs in f.
scopes.powers: The denominator power has real exponent (n : ℝ)/2. r^2 has natural exponent 2.
scopes.division: Real division/inverse and real powers retain the totalized definitions in the approved context.
scopes.premise_boundary: No integrability, moment formula, support claim, or additional positivity claim is an assumption or an extra conclusion of this reconstruction.

constant_dependencies.n: Universally quantified natural dimension, at least 3.
constant_dependencies.kappa: Universally quantified real parameter, at least 4.
constant_dependencies.s_r: Explicitly determined by n and κ as displayed; s depends only on κ.
constant_dependencies.tau_sigma: Determined by n and the displayed standard Euclidean volume construction.
constant_dependencies.f_and_integral_value: Determined entirely by n and κ; no unspecified constants.

read_actions.action: Read both permitted inputs in full with cat.
Read the same two input files as bytes in Python, parse their JSON, compute raw-file hashes, and construct these result files.

run_evidence.reconstruction_basis: Only the lean.statement and lean.approved_definition_context fields in the respective input packet; packet metadata is copied solely for provenance.
run_evidence.verification: Each reconstruction hash is computed from its exact UTF-8 text. Each run hash is computed over every other field in its result object using the recorded canonicalization convention. Output construction and hash checks are performed in memory, without reading any additional file.

decoder_run_hash_convention: UTF-8 SHA-256 of json.dumps(result with decoder_run_sha256 omitted, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")); all other top-level and nested fields are included, object keys are sorted, array order is preserved, and no terminal newline is included in the hashed bytes.
